body:
My note from before dawn: the field trial crew carried sealed seed packet. my brother started coughing. I had not yet heard that the county van arrived.

I took the page when they shut the building. No one could tell me whether the missing line meant delayed, refused, or already gone.

It may have started elsewhere; none of us saw the beginning. I only know what had reached this place before they closed the road.
title: Before dawn: sealed seed packet
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.
